newsitem.title: USA: Veritas DGC signs contract for new vessel.
newsitem.headline: Veritas DGC signs contract for new vessel.

text.p: Veritas DGC said on Friday that it had signed a contract for the first of a new class of 3D seismic vessels, potentially the largest vessel in its fleet.
The new vessel, which will be owned and operated by Eidesvik Survey A/S, is scheduled to enter service in the first part of 1998, Veritas said in a statement.

"In anticipation of ever increasing towing power demands, resulting from requirements to tow increasingly wider spreads of streamers, the vessel's power train has been designed to deliver more propulsion power than any seismic vessel currently afloat," Veritas said.
Veritas DGC Inc provides land and marine-based seismic data acquisition and seismic data processing services to the petroleum industry.
